description: This file implements the SugarOAuthServer class, which facilitates OAuth authentication within the SuiteCRM application. It manages OAuth tokens, verifies requests, and interacts with OAuth key storage. The class includes methods for issuing request and access tokens, checking request validity, and handling OAuth provider setup.

classes.name: SugarOAuthServer
classes.description: A class providing OAuth support for SuiteCRM, handling token generation, validation, and OAuth request processing.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if required PHP functions for cryptographic hashing are available.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Static method to determine if OAuth support is enabled based on available PHP functions.

methods.name: lookupConsumer
methods.description: Finds and verifies a consumer by its key during OAuth request processing.

methods.name: timestampNonceChecker
methods.description: Checks the validity of timestamps and nonces to prevent replay attacks.

methods.name: tokenHandler
methods.description: Validates incoming OAuth tokens and manages token state transitions.

methods.name: decodePostGet
methods.description: Decodes and sanitizes incoming GET and POST parameters for OAuth requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth provider, verifies OAuth requests, and optionally performs cleanup.

methods.name: requestToken
methods.description: Generates a new OAuth request token for client applications.

methods.name: accessToken
methods.description: Generates an OAuth access token after a valid request token has been authorized.

methods.name: authUrl
methods.description: Provides the URL for user authorization.

methods.name: authorizedToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current authorized OAuth token if available.

methods.name: authorization
methods.description: Returns authorization data associated with the current token.

methods.name: reportProblem
methods.description: Generates a string describing OAuth-related errors.
